title: He operated on a patient 10,000 km away. The round trip took under 150 milliseconds.

sources.text: GlobeNewswire - SS Innovations Demonstrates Long-Distance Telesurgery Capabilities at Royal Australian College of Surgeons Annual Scientific Congress
MassDevice - SS Innovations demonstrates long-distance telerobotic surgery capabilities over 4,500 miles

caption:
He operated on a patient 10,000 km away. The round trip took under 150 milliseconds.

On May 2, 2026, he remotely performed a live robotic gastrojejunostomy on a patient in Indore while operating from Perth, Australia - roughly 10,000 km away - using SS Innovations' SSI Mantra telesurgery system, during the Royal Australasian College of Surgeons' Annual Scientific Congress.

The demonstration recorded round-trip latency under 150 milliseconds - fast enough for precise surgical control across continents - and completed the procedure in about three minutes, a landmark for how close long-distance robotic telesurgery is to real clinical use.

Telesurgery at this latency means a surgeon's expertise can travel instantly, even when the surgeon can't - a real path toward closing India's rural-urban specialist gap.
